This notebook runs the reduced 4-mode reference script for the requested checks and prints the results inline.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys


def find_reference_script() -> Path:
    candidates = [
        Path("notebooks/63_reduced_4mode_reference.py"),
        Path("notebooks/reduced_4mode_reference.py"),
        Path("63_reduced_4mode_reference.py"),
        Path("reduced_4mode_reference.py"),
    ]
    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate.exists():
            return candidate.resolve()
    raise FileNotFoundError("Could not find the reduced 4-mode reference script.")


script = find_reference_script()
commands = [
    ["--run-tests"],
    ["--one-case", "--a", "45", "--b", "22.5"],
    ["--mc", "--a", "45", "--b", "22.5", "--trials", "50000"],
    ["--chsh"],
]

for args in commands:
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script), *args]
    print("$", " ".join(cmd))
    completed = subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    stdout = completed.stdout.strip()
    if stdout:
        print(stdout)
    if completed.stderr.strip():
        print(completed.stderr.strip())
    print()
```
